title: PARALLAX / DREAMSTATE V4 dependence-aware robustness
summary: PARALLAX V4 adds episode-aware effective sample size, Newey-West/HAC dependence-adjusted inference, and cross-revision contradiction/transportability diagnostics on top of V3 temporal and parameter-basin robustness. DREAMSTATE V4 carries these diagnostics into policy contracts, Brain mirrors, search accounting, refresh, and live source revalidation. All authority remains research/shadow only.
evidence: context.episode_id collapses repeated decisions into one effective episode mean
raw evidence N and effective N remain separately visible
Newey-West/HAC uncertainty replaces naive screen uncertainty when evaluable
Benjamini-Hochberg FDR consumes dependence-adjusted p-values when HAC is active
cross-revision diagnostics never pool effect sizes
strong contradictory revisions block robust readiness for matching mutation families
DREAMSTATE carries dependence diagnostics into policy contracts and Adaptive Brain mirrors
V3 temporal folds and parameter-basin robustness preserved
